entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add a new SDK Resolver that can load an Sdk by relative path #51367
  • Roslyn diagnostic suppressors not respected by `dotnet format` #51364
  • [Wix 5]The installer icons for .NET SDK/Runtime/Hosting bundle show the old MSI icon instead of the .NET icon #51363
    Backlog
  • After installing .NET SDK 10.0 RTM, creating 9.0 project requires November Servicing (9.0.11) feeds #51362
  • AOT tests failing when targeting downlevel on dev18 images #51361

Closed

  • [dotnet-watch] .NET 10 RC2, browser doesn't update on first change of razor page #51107
    10.0.1xx
  • System.Drawing.Common pruning leads to a compile error when only UseWPF is specified #51173
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With .NET10 GA installed, the size of total published folder for Blazor Wasm with AOT enable is the same with AOT disable. #51258
  • [WebToolsE2E] The 8.0/9.0 implicit runtime(8.0.19/9.0.8) is not the same with VS carries(8.0.21/9.0.10) after installing SDK 10.0 GA. #51303
  • dotnet cli version 3.0.100-rc1-014190 still generate *.SLN with # Visual Studio 15 #10500
    Backlog
  • dotnet format adds RequiresUnreferencedCode attributes in .NET 10 RC2 #51326

Created

  • Add basic ability to get latest version and install to installation library #51374
  • Add source package for file-based programs support #51373
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Run tests for `dnup` branch across all 3 OS in PRs #51372
  • Update --project/--solution descriptions for dotnet test (MTP) #51371
  • Update License Scan tests to use container #51369
  • Add FileBasedSdkResolver for loading SDKs from relative paths #51368
  • Delete unused NuGet source #51365

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #51330
  • Cherry-pick PR #50749 to release/10.0.1xx: Update compatibility message for targeting .NET 10.0 in Visual Studio 17.14 #51366
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.0
  • Sync Main into `dnup` branch #51370
  • Run `dnup` tests in the `dnup` branch pipeline if only dnup code changed #51349
  • Update baseline manifests for .NET 10 RC 2 #51313
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #51321
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51324

    Servicing-consider
